title: FSP-CEG-BIG-STAG Experimental Archive
description: Executable reproducibility archive for the Full-Stack Philosophy (FSP), Corrigible Ethical Governance (CEG), BIG STAG, recursive-inquiry, and organizational/emergence synthetic experimental lineage. The archive preserves historical source packages, runnable snapshots, audits, acceptance records, fresh rerun receipts, provenance maps, claim ceilings, and checksum manifests. Fresh verification reproduced 269/269 tests for the BIG STAG 2F lineage and 300/300 tests for the inherited emergence lineage. Computational reproducibility does not establish empirical validity, real-world effectiveness, or normative superiority.
